empires.description: The Star Fleet Universe features numerous empires, each with unique ships, weapons, technology, and combat doctrines. Empires are grouped by their galaxy of origin.

alphaOctant.name: United Earth Federation
alphaOctant.description: A democratic alliance of star systems led by Earth. NATO analogue. The most well-known empire in the SFU.
alphaOctant.combatStyle: Balanced fleet with strong phasers and photon torpedoes. Relies on speed, maneuverability, and drone weapons.
alphaOctant.seekingWeapons: Drones — Federation doctrine emphasizes drone fire.
alphaOctant.fleetComposition: Heavy cruisers, light cruisers, war cruisers, dreadnoughts, scouts, fleet tugs, carriers
alphaOctant.pointValue: Moderate — balanced ships with good all-around capability

alphaOctant.name: Klingon Empire
alphaOctant.description: A militaristic empire obsessed with honor and combat. Soviet Union analogue.
alphaOctant.combatStyle: Aggressive close-range combat with heavy disruptors and torpedoes. Ships have strong shields and heavy armor.
alphaOctant.uniqueFeatures: Only empire with the B10 Battleship (superheavy). Other races have conjectural battleship designs in R5.
alphaOctant.pointValue: High — heavy ships with strong offensive capability

alphaOctant.name: Romulan Star Empire
alphaOctant.description: A secretive empire descended from exiled Romulans. China with Roman names analogue. Uses Klingon-designed ships similarly to how Communist China used Soviet warcraft.
alphaOctant.combatStyle: Cloaking device users who strike from invisibility. Strong plasma torpedo doctrine.
alphaOctant.seekingWeapons: Plasma Torpedoes — core of Romulan doctrine.
alphaOctant.uniqueFeatures: Cloaking devices on most ships. Plasma torpedo doctrine.
alphaOctant.pointValue: Moderate to high — cloaking adds tactical value

alphaOctant.name: Gorn Empire
alphaOctant.description: A reptilian race with few but very good ships. Germany analogue. Steady alliance with the Federation.
alphaOctant.combatStyle: Seeking-weapon doctrine with plasma torpedoes. Heavy, well-armored ships.
alphaOctant.uniqueFeatures: Gorn Anchor — using tractor beams to prevent victims from launching wild weasel decoys.
alphaOctant.pointValue: High — fewer ships but each is very capable

alphaOctant.name: Kzinti Empire
alphaOctant.description: Cat-like bipedal humanoids. Imperial Japan circa 1941 analogue. Later alliance with the Federation.
alphaOctant.combatStyle: Seeking-weapon doctrine with drones and plasma. Fast, aggressive ships.
alphaOctant.uniqueFeatures: Carrier-based fighter operations. Combined drone and plasma doctrine.

alphaOctant.name: Tholian Empire
alphaOctant.description: Insectoid race from the M81 Galaxy. Masters of web technology.
alphaOctant.combatStyle: Defensive warfare using Tholian webs to trap and restrict enemy movement. Ambush tactics.
alphaOctant.uniqueFeatures: Tholian Web Trap — casts a one-hex web directly behind the ship to restrict pursuers.
alphaOctant.pointValue: Moderate — webs provide strong defensive capability

alphaOctant.name: Orion Pirates
alphaOctant.description: Rogue pirates from the Orion sector. Not a formal empire but a significant threat.
alphaOctant.combatStyle: Hit-and-run tactics with stolen and modified ships. Unpredictable.
specialSystems: Varies — may use any available technology
alphaOctant.uniqueFeatures: Can use technology from multiple empires. Pirate ships cannot use empire-specific heavy weapons like Jindarian rail guns.

alphaOctant.name: Hydran Empire
alphaOctant.description: A seafaring empire. United Kingdom analogue. Introduced in early expansions.
alphaOctant.combatStyle: Gatling phaser doctrine with rapid-fire energy weapons. Strong fusion beams.
alphaOctant.uniqueFeatures: Gatling phasers fire multiple shots per turn. Fusion beams score half-again damage when overloaded.

alphaOctant.name: Lyran Empire
alphaOctant.description: Cat-like bipedal humanoids from a different lineage than the Kzinti. Vaguely reminiscent of pre-British Arabs.
alphaOctant.combatStyle: Fast, agile ships with strong offensive capability.

alphaOctant.name: WYN Cluster
alphaOctant.description: A cluster of allied systems with unique technology.

alphaOctant.name: Inter-Stellar Concordium (ISC)
alphaOctant.description: A coalition of systems with advanced technology.
alphaOctant.combatStyle: Advanced weapons including the Plasmatic Pulsar Device.
alphaOctant.uniqueFeatures: Plasmatic Pulsar Device scores half-again damage when overloaded.

andromedaGalaxy.name: Andromedan Empire
andromedaGalaxy.description: Extraterrestrial invaders from the Andromeda Galaxy. The greatest threat in the SFU timeline.
andromedaGalaxy.combatStyle: Overwhelming force with tractor-repulsor beams as primary weapons. Transporter bomb tactics.
andromedaGalaxy.uniqueFeatures: Tractor-repulsor beams shake targets to pieces. T-bombs are a favorite tactic. Space amoebas as biological weapons.

m81Galaxy.name: Neo-Tholians
m81Galaxy.description: Descendants or variants of the Tholians from the M81 Galaxy.
m81Galaxy.combatStyle: Web-based tactics similar to Alpha Octant Tholians.

m81Galaxy.name: Seltorians (M81)
m81Galaxy.description: M81 Galaxy variant of the Seltorians.

m81Galaxy.name: M81 Pirates
m81Galaxy.description: Pirate factions operating in the M81 Galaxy.

otherEmpires.name: Branthodon
otherEmpires.description: Use controlled, cybernetically enhanced space dragons as ships. Living ship concept.
otherEmpires.uniqueFeatures: Space dragons as living vessels. Cybernetic enhancement allows combat capability.
otherEmpires.combatStyle: Unconventional — living ships with biological weapons and unique movement patterns.

otherEmpires.name: Jindarians
otherEmpires.description: Empire with warp-augmented rail guns in light, medium, and heavy variants. Known for their devastating heavy weapons.
otherEmpires.uniqueFeatures: Warp-Augmented Rail Guns require two consecutive turns to arm. Once armed, they deliver massive damage.
otherEmpires.combatStyle: Heavy weapon doctrine centered around rail guns. Ships are heavily armed but may be slower.

otherEmpires.name: Eneen
otherEmpires.description: Empire with variable-focus neutron beams and Type-E plasma torpedoes. Masters of adaptive weapon systems.
otherEmpires.uniqueFeatures: Variable-Focus Neutron Beam can fire in narrow aperture (hit-or-miss, high damage) or wide aperture (spread damage across multiple targets).
otherEmpires.combatStyle: Adaptive weapon doctrine with neutron beams and plasma torpedoes.

otherEmpires.name: LMC (Lyran Merchant Consortium)
otherEmpires.description: Uses warp-tuned lasers as phaser-equivalent weapons. Merchant-based empire with strong trade networks.
otherEmpires.uniqueFeatures: Warp-tuned lasers come in light, medium, and heavy variants. Function as phaser equivalents.
otherEmpires.combatStyle: Merchant fleet doctrine with laser weapons. Strong economic base supports fleet operations.

otherEmpires.name: Nicozians
otherEmpires.description: Smaller empire known for their unique ship designs and tactical flexibility.
otherEmpires.combatStyle: Flexible tactics with mixed weapon systems.

otherEmpires.name: Vudar
otherEmpires.description: Smaller empire with strong defensive capabilities and unique technology.
otherEmpires.combatStyle: Defensive doctrine with strong shields and point-defense systems.

otherEmpires.name: Borak
otherEmpires.description: Smaller empire with aggressive combat style and unique ship designs.
otherEmpires.combatStyle: Aggressive close-range combat with heavy weapons.

otherEmpires.name: Carnivons
otherEmpires.description: Extinct empire — xenocided by the Kzinti and Lyran alliance. Known for death bolt weapons. Rumors of exiles in the Sargasso Storm Zone.
otherEmpires.combatStyle: Death bolt doctrine — drone-like weapons unique to the Carnivons.
otherEmpires.uniqueFeatures: Death bolts are drone-like weapons that ended with the Carnivon xenocide. Module C6 provides rules for how they would have evolved.

otherEmpires.name: Peladine
otherEmpires.description: Smaller empire with unique characteristics and ship designs.
otherEmpires.combatStyle: Varies — smaller fleet with specialized ships.

otherEmpires.name: Jumokian
otherEmpires.description: Pirate faction operating in the Alpha Octant. Known for raiding and hit-and-run tactics.
otherEmpires.combatStyle: Pirate hit-and-run tactics with stolen and modified ships.

otherEmpires.name: Zosman
otherEmpires.description: Pirate faction operating in the Alpha Octant. Similar to Jumokians but with different operational areas.

otherEmpires.name: Seltorians
otherEmpires.description: Empire known for their unique technology and diplomatic approach.
otherEmpires.combatStyle: Balanced fleet with emphasis on diplomacy and scientific research.

otherEmpires.name: Paravians
otherEmpires.description: Empire from the Omega Sector with unique nest defense platforms and advanced technology.
